description: The sheet's rows, one for each plan of each call, each with every key of the sheet's JSON download: its provider, plan, billing, $ per 1,000 (perThousand), score out of 100 (score), rate limits, speed, the fields it returns and the pages we read it from. total counts every row found, plans holds up to limit of them from offset. What each key means: https://datacircle.dev/fields

api.description: The API, its name as list_apis gives it. Every API when left out.

limit.description: How many plans to give, 1 to 50. 10 when left out.

offset.description: How many found plans to skip first. 0 when left out.

query.description: Words that must all appear in the provider's or plan's name, ignoring case and accents.

sort.description: score, the default: best first, as on the sheet at datacircle.dev, each API's plans together, unscored plans last. provider: A to Z. price: $ per 1,000, lowest first.

name: search_plans
title: Search the API plans
